messages:
maria: quick heads-up — i'm experimenting with normalizing the /v1/generate param we currently call `model_hint`. idea: accept a `region:tier` shorthand (eg `us-east-1:standard`) so router can prefer region-local pools. keeping full `model_id` behavior, this is just an additional hint.

aj: can you paste a sample request/response? curious if this changes client parsing.

maria: sure — example payload:
```json
{
  "prompt": "Summarize the Q2 goals",
  "model_hint": "eu-west-1:dedicated",
  "max_tokens": 256
}
```
and we might add a small response field so callers can see what actually routed:
```json
{
  "text": "...",
  "model_selected": "redwood/gpt-3b-q8_0-eu-west1"
}
```

sophie: adding `model_selected` seems fine, but is that a breaking change? some SDK users parse the whole response, others just use streaming chunks.

kevin: should be non-breaking if we only append a new top-level string. just need to call it out in the contract. streaming is the tricky part — do we emit the header early or a trailing metadata message?

maria: good Q. my plan: for streaming we emit a one-line JSON metadata event before tokens over the same stream channel, e.g. `event: metadata, data: { model_selected: ... }`. for non-streaming, include `model_selected` after the text.

aj: nit: consider `routing_hint` as name to avoid confusion with `model_id`. also define precedence explicitly: 1) explicit `model_id` wins, 2) `routing_hint` (region:tier) used to select compatible model variants, 3) account default.

maria: agreed on precedence. i'm ok renaming — want to keep `model_hint` for backwards compat for now, but accept `routing_hint` as new alias in the incoming payload. server will accept both.

kevin: on fallback behavior, what if no capacity in requested region/tier? fallback order?

maria: proposal:
- try region:tier exact match
- fallback to same region any tier
- fallback to any-region same tier (if policy allows cross-region)
- final fallback to account default model pool

sophie: do we need a per-request flag to disable cross-region fallbacks for data residency customers?

maria: yes — add `avoid_cross_region_fallback: true` optional boolean. default false.

aj: what about versioning? if we add `model_selected` and `routing_hint` alias, should we bump contract to v1.1 header or keep v1 and feature-flag rollout? some customers pin an exact contract.

maria: we'll feature-flag behind `api_version` header. default behavior stays v1 until we flip. docs will show v1.1 behavior with examples. migration plan: shallow rollout + console banner + SDK update.

kevin: sounds good. can we add an endpoint test matrix in CI that covers: explicit model_id, routing_hint exact, routing_hint with fallback, avoid_cross_region_fallback, streaming metadata event?

maria: yes — i'll add tests. pinging @sophie for API contract review and docs wording :eyes:

sophie: i'll take a look tomorrow morning. small suggestion: make the `model_selected` stable (string token) and ensure it's consistent across multi-chunk streams. also add a short schema snippet for the metadata event.

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: api-contract/feature/routing-hints -> staging at 2026-03-17T14:30Z :rocket:

aj: one more thought — telemetry: include `routing_choice` enum in logs (exact_match, region_fallback, cross_region_fallback, default_pool) so we can track regressions.

maria: good call. i'll add that to the response headers (X-Routing-Choice) and to internal metrics. thanks all — i'll open the PR and link tests + docs in this thread.

kevin: thanks — LMK when PR is up and i'll review.

maria: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/inference/pull/1728 — includes server + sdk alias, tests, and docs.

sophie: reviewed at a high level, left a couple of wording comments on the docs. :+1:

aj: quick code review ping @kevin @sophie — small API surface but important to get compat wording right.

kevin: will do this afternoon.

maria: last_message — thanks everyone. will merge after kevin + sophie sign-off. :white_check_mark:
